summary: Intercont (Cayman) Limited filed a 6-K attaching a press release announcing the effective time of a 25-for-1 reverse share split, effective September 17, 2026, approved by the board on September 5, 2026 after prior shareholder authorization. The consolidation aims to regain compliance with Nasdaq's $1.00 minimum bid price rule. Authorized Class A shares fall from 80,000,000,000 to 3,200,000,000 and par rises from $0.0025 to $0.0625; issued Class A drops from 25,437,740 to 1,017,510. Trading continues under NCT with new CUSIP G48049129. This is a compliance-driven capital-structure maintenance event, not a special situation.
